chat.author: Lorenzo Colitti
chat.text: dnsmasq has this weird "probing" behaviour where it hits all its configured resolvers after it gets any error

chat.author: David Lawrence
chat.text: Servfail behaves this way both because it is not cacheable and it also carries a connotation that the server is just having a transient problem.

chat.author: Warren Kumari
chat.text: yup. THere was a draft to cache SERVFAIL...

chat.author: David Lawrence
chat.text: If my resolver gets a servfail from ns1, it is pretty reasonable to try ns2.

chat.author: Warren Kumari
chat.text: (per server)

chat.author: Erik Nygren
chat.text: And returning SERVFAIL can be useful for saying "try another instance / authority without waiting" (eg, for cases where you know config isn't present there yet in deployments with multiple authorities)

chat.author: Erik Nygren
chat.text: Having recursives and stubs do exponential back-off on receiving SERVFAIL from any one instance would be good if not already there.
